INSERT INTO mis_stock( goods_id, goods_code, goods_name, goods_spec, unit, goods_type, warehouse_id, area_id, shelf_id, location_id, batch_no, production_date, shelf_life, expiry_date, quantity, in_detail_id, production_batch_id, create_by, create_time, sys_org_code, supplier_id, supplier_name, stock_in_time, original_qty ) VALUES
( #{item.goodsId}, #{item.goodsCode}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.goodsSpec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.goodsType}, #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.areaId}, #{item.shelfId}, #{item.locationId}, #{item.batchNo}, #{item.productionDate}, #{item.shelfLife}, #{item.expiryDate}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.inDetailId}, #{item.productionBatchId}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.sysOrgCode}, #{item.supplierId}, #{item.supplierName}, #{item.stockInTime}, #{item.originalQty} )
mapper.select:
SELECT s.goods_id as goodsId, s.goods_code as goodsCode, s.goods_name as goodsName, s.goods_spec as goodsSpec, s.unit as unit, s.goods_type as goodsType, s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, MAX(w.name) as warehouseName, SUM(s.quantity) as totalQty, SUM(s.locked_qty) as totalLockedQty, SUM(s.quantity - s.locked_qty) as availableQty, COUNT(DISTINCT s.batch_no) as batchCount, MIN(s.stock_in_time) as firstInTime, MAX(s.stock_in_time) as lastInTime, MIN(s.expiry_date) as nearestExpiryDate, SUM(CASE WHEN s.expiry_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expiredBatchCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.expiry_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nearExpiryBatchCount FROM mis_stock s LEFT JOIN mis_warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.del_flag = '0'

mapper.update: UPDATE mis_stock SET quantity = quantity + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(quantity) as totalQty, SUM(locked_qty) as lockedQty, SUM(quantity - locked_qty) as availableQty, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as batchCount FROM mis_stock WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} AND quantity > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( -- 缺货或积压预警 SELECT s.goods_id FROM mis_stock s WHERE s.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY s.goods_id HAVING SUM(s.quantity) <= MAX(CASE WHEN s.safety_stock_qty > 0 THEN s.safety_stock_qty END) OR SUM(s.quantity) >= MAX(CASE WHEN s.max_stock_qty > 0 THEN s.max_stock_qty END)
UNION
-- 效期预警（关联物料/产品表获取预警天数） SELECT s.goods_id FROM mis_stock s LEFT JOIN mis_material m ON s.goods_id = m.id AND s.is_product = '0' LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON s.goods_id = p.id AND s.is_product = '1' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND s.quantity > 0 AND s.expiry_date >= CURDATE() AND s.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD( CURDATE(), INTERVAL COALESCE(m.expiry_alert_days, p.expiry_alert_days, 30) DAY ) GROUP BY s.goods_id ) t
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(locked_qty), 0) FROM mis_stock WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.goods_id AS materialId, MAX(s.goods_code) AS materialCode, MAX(s.goods_name) AS materialName, MAX(s.goods_spec) AS spec, SUM(s.quantity) AS availableQty, MAX(s.safety_stock_qty) AS safetyStock, MAX(s.max_stock_qty) AS maxStock, MAX(m.expiry_alert_days) AS materialAlertDays, MAX(p.expiry_alert_days) AS productAlertDays, MAX(s.is_product) AS isProduct, MIN(s.expiry_date) AS nearestExpiryDate, SUM(CASE WHEN s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND s.expiry_date >= CURDATE() AND s.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS expiryQty FROM mis_stock s LEFT JOIN mis_material m ON s.goods_id = m.id AND s.is_product = '0' LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON s.goods_id = p.id AND s.is_product = '1' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND (s.safety_stock_qty > 0 OR s.max_stock_qty > 0 OR s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY s.goods_id HAVING SUM(s.quantity) <= MAX(CASE WHEN s.safety_stock_qty > 0 THEN s.safety_stock_qty END) OR SUM(s.quantity) >= MAX(CASE WHEN s.max_stock_qty > 0 THEN s.max_stock_qty END) OR MIN(s.expiry_date) IS NOT NULL ) t ORDER BY CASE WHEN availableQty <= safetyStock THEN 1 WHEN availableQty >= maxStock THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ABS( CASE WHEN availableQty <= safetyStock THEN safetyStock - availableQty WHEN availableQty >= maxStock THEN availableQty - maxStock ELSE 0 END ) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT s.id as stockId, s.goods_id as materialId, s.goods_code as materialCode, s.goods_name as materialName, s.goods_spec as spec, s.batch_no as batchNo, s.quantity as quantity, s.expiry_date as expiryDate, DATEDIFF(s.expiry_date, CURDATE()) as remainDays, COALESCE(m.expiry_alert_days, p.expiry_alert_days, 30) as alertDays, s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, s.area_id as areaId, s.shelf_id as shelfId, s.location_id as locationId FROM mis_stock s LEFT JOIN mis_material m ON s.goods_id = m.id AND s.goods_type = '0' LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON s.goods_id = p.id AND s.goods_type = '1' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.quantity > 0 AND s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND s.expiry_date >= CURDATE() AND s.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD( CURDATE(), INTERVAL COALESCE(m.expiry_alert_days, p.expiry_alert_days, 30) DAY ) ORDER BY s.expiry_date ASC, s.quantity DESC LIMIT 10
